message.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We acknowledge your request for an increased volume of 23,400 units and a 24-month contract term. 

We offer a revised price of €32.00 per unit, reflecting the adjusted volume and contract duration. Consequently, our Angebot comprises a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months. In recognition of this longer-term commitment, we are prepared to adjust our price to EUR 31.80 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer reflects a significant concession on our part and represents a sustainable basis for our continued cooperation.

Our offer stands at a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
